Employee Policy Question: How many casual leave days are employees entitled to?
Answer: Employees are entitled to 12 casual leave days per year. Source: leave_policy.txt

Source: leave_policy.txt
Leave Policy Employees are entitled to 12 casual leave days per year. Employees are entitled to 15 sick leave days per year. Casual leave should normally be requested at least one day in advance. Sick leave may be requested on the day of absence when necessary. Unused casual leave cannot be carried forward to the next year.

Source: working_hours_policy.txt
Working Hours Policy The standard working hours are 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM, Monday to Friday. Employees have a one-hour lunch break. Employees should inform their manager if they expect to arrive late. Remote employees must remain available during standard working hours. Employees may work remotely when remote work has been approved by their manager.

Reimbursement Policy Employees can claim reimbursement for approved business travel expenses. Meal expenses are reimbursed up to Rs. 500 per day. Local transportation expenses are reimbursed when they are related to official business. Employees must submit reimbursement claims within 30 days of the expense. Original receipts or valid digital receipts must be provided with the claim.
